Public sample product specification — reusable synthetic test text.

The package contains one stainless-steel bottle, one silicone gasket, and two replacement filters. The nominal capacity is 750 mL. The bottle body is made from grade 304 stainless steel, and the gasket is food-grade silicone. The product is not intended for microwave use. Do not claim that it is waterproof or suitable for carbonated beverages.

Each retail unit must carry a legible SKU label. The outer carton contains 24 retail units and has a target gross weight of 9.6 kg. Inspectors must scan the unit label before sealing the carton. A successful scan does not replace a visual check of the printed text. If the label is blurred, set the inspection result to FAIL and hold the carton for review.

For orders of 300–499 units, the sample price is $12.50 per unit; for orders of 500 units or more, the sample price is $11.80 per unit. These prices exclude freight and tax. The quoted lead time is 18–22 business days after artwork approval, excluding transit. Do not start mass production while the artwork is pending.

The supplier must provide photographs of the first completed unit and the sealed master carton. The buyer must confirm both images in writing before dispatch. If 2 or more units in the sample lot fail inspection, request a corrective-action report instead of automatically issuing a refund. Keep the invoice amount unchanged until the parties approve a revised document.
